EMERGING_DYNAMIC_VERTICAL.reason: Public attention is strongly self-collectable, but independent market-activity confirmation remains unresolved.
EMERGING_DYNAMIC_VERTICAL.remediation: Add independent activity/venue evidence; never promote attention to demand or transaction.

REGIONAL.reason: Regional public representation can be probed, but the Regional contract requires >=2 independent source families plus institutional/release/venue evidence.
REGIONAL.remediation: Add independent regional institution/release/venue family and validate mapping grammar.

SCARCE_ILLIQUID.reason: Scarcity evidence and illiquidity evidence are distinct; illiquidity cannot be inferred without actual activity/availability history.
SCARCE_ILLIQUID.remediation: Acquire temporal activity/availability evidence and keep missing-data != illiquidity.

HIGH_LIQUIDITY_OR_ACTIVE_MARKET.reason: Liquidity requires verified activity/frequency evidence; listings, bid/ask and attention cannot substitute for sold/activity history.
HIGH_LIQUIDITY_OR_ACTIVE_MARKET.remediation: Quantify rights-safe activity sources and verified sold-event capability.

EDGE_CASE.reason: Scope-specific identity grammar can nominate boundary stressors, but candidate-specific boundary evidence has not been independently completed for all Scopes.
EDGE_CASE.remediation: Use scope grammar to nominate and require explicit boundary-stressor evidence before SELECTED.
